import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans,AgglomerativeClustering
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
z=np.load('donor_aggregates.npz'); D=z['donor_names'];G=z['gene_names'];C=z['count_sum'];n=np.array([int(x[5:]) for x in D]);
# TMM-ish pseudobulk: log CPM, restrict reasonably expressed and variable
L=np.log2(1+C/C.sum(1)[:,None]*1e6)
keep=(C>0).sum(0)>=20
X=L[:,keep]; genes=G[keep]
# center genes; scale only cap low variance to prevent composition genes alone dominating
X-=X.mean(0)
var=X.var(0); sel=var>np.quantile(var,.5)
X=X[:,sel]
p=PCA(n_components=10).fit_transform(X)
print('PCA variance and coordinates')
print(PCA(n_components=10).fit(X).explained_variance_ratio_)
for i in np.argsort(n):print(f'{n[i]:2d}', ' '.join(f'{v:8.2f}' for v in p[i,:5]))
for dims in [2,3,5,10]:
 for seed in [1,2,3,4,5]:
  lab=KMeans(2,random_state=seed,n_init=20).fit_predict(p[:,:dims]); groups=[]
  for x in [0,1]:groups.append(sorted(n[lab==x].tolist()))
  groups.sort(key=len)
  print('KM',dims,seed,groups)
for link in ['ward','complete','average']:
 lab=AgglomerativeClustering(2,linkage=link).fit_predict(p[:,:10]);groups=[sorted(n[lab==x].tolist()) for x in [0,1]];groups.sort(key=len);print('AG',link,groups)
# provisional differential healthy set
H=np.isin(n,[1,5,11,12,17,21,24,27,29,32]); diff=L[~H].mean(0)-L[H].mean(0)
print('\\nTop COVID enriched')
for j in np.argsort(diff)[-80:][::-1]:print(G[j],round(diff[j],3),round(L[H,j].mean(),2),round(L[~H,j].mean(),2))
print('\\nTop healthy enriched')
for j in np.argsort(diff)[:50]:print(G[j],round(diff[j],3))

import numpy as np
z=np.load('donor_aggregates.npz');D=z['donor_names'];G=z['gene_names'];C=z['count_sum'];Det=z['detected_cells'];dc=z['donor_code'];n=np.array([int(x[5:]) for x in D]);nc=np.bincount(dc,minlength=33)
# Detection fraction: equal cell weighting, robust arcsine transform, genes detected in 1-95% overall
F=Det/nc[:,None]
mu=F.mean(0); keep=(mu>.001)&(mu<.95)
X=np.arcsin(np.sqrt(F[:,keep])); X-=X.mean(0)
u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(X,full_matrices=False); P=u*s
# orient so S100A8 is positive
j=np.flatnonzero(G[keep]=='S100A8')[0]
if vt[0,j]<0:P[:,0]*=-1;vt[0]*=-1
print('Detection PCA1, ordered')
for i in np.argsort(n):print(f'{n[i]:2d} {P[i,0]:9.4f} {P[i,1]:9.4f}')
print('largest PC1 gap')
ss=np.sort(P[:,0]); print(np.diff(ss));print('split',sorted(n[P[:,0]<(ss[np.argmax(np.diff(ss))]+ss[np.argmax(np.diff(ss))+1])/2].tolist()))
print('top positive loadings')
GG=G[keep]
for j in np.argsort(vt[0])[-50:][::-1]:print(GG[j],round(vt[0,j],4))
print('top negative loadings')
for j in np.argsort(vt[0])[:40]:print(GG[j],round(vt[0,j],4))
# fixed biological modules using log CPM values, median z-score across genes
cpm=C/C.sum(1)[:,None]*1e6; L=np.log2(1+cpm)
mods={
 'ISG':['ISG15','IFI6','IFIT1','IFIT2','IFIT3','MX1','OAS1','OAS2','IFI27','IFI44L','RSAD2','USP18','SIGLEC1'],
 'inflam':['S100A8','S100A9','S100A12','FCN1','CTSD','FCGR1A','CTSS','MCEMP1','APOBEC3A','SOCS3'],
 'cycling':['MKI67','TOP2A','UBE2C','TYMS','RRM2','BIRC5','CCNA2','CCNB2'],
 'healthyDC':['FCER1A','CD1C','CLEC10A','CLEC4C','LILRA4'],
 'Tcell':['CD3D','CD3E','TRBC1','IL7R','CCR7','LTB','MALAT1'],
}
print('module scores (median centered gene z)')
score={}
for name,gs in mods.items():
 ix=np.array([np.flatnonzero(G==g)[0] for g in gs if np.any(G==g)])
 Z=(L[:,ix]-L[:,ix].mean(0))/(L[:,ix].std(0)+1e-9)
 score[name]=np.median(Z,1)
print('id '+' '.join(f'{x:>9s}' for x in mods))
for i in np.argsort(n):print(f'{n[i]:2d} '+' '.join(f'{score[x][i]:9.3f}' for x in mods))
PY"

import numpy as np
z=np.load('donor_aggregates.npz');D=z['donor_names'];G=z['gene_names'];C=z['count_sum'];n=np.array([int(x[5:]) for x in D]);L=np.log2(1+C/C.sum(1)[:,None]*1e6)
H=np.isin(n,[1,5,11,12,17,21,24,27,29,32]); V=~H
muH=L[H].mean(0); sdH=L[H].std(0)+.2
for donor in [1,19,22,25,27,32]:
 i=np.flatnonzero(n==donor)[0]; Z=(L[i]-muH)/sdH
 # restrict genes at least moderate in donor or healthy
 keep=(L[i]>2)|(muH>2)
 ix=np.where(keep)[0][np.argsort(Z[keep])[-35:][::-1]]
 print('\\nDONOR',donor,'top vs healthy')
 print(' '.join(f'{G[j]}:{Z[j]:.1f}' for j in ix))
# global logCPM PCA optimal 2means on PC1 and score ordering
keep=(C>0).sum(0)>=20;X=L[:,keep];X-=X.mean(0); vv=X.var(0);X=X[:,vv>np.quantile(vv,.5)]
u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(X,full_matrices=False); p=u[:,0]*s[0]
# orient healthy-looking negative based S100A8
if np.corrcoef(p,L[:,np.flatnonzero(G=='S100A8')[0]])[0,1]<0:p=-p
order=np.argsort(p); ss=p[order]
best=None
for k in range(2,len(n)-1):
 sse=((ss[:k]-ss[:k].mean())**2).sum()+((ss[k:]-ss[k:].mean())**2).sum()
 if best is None or sse<best[0]:best=(sse,k)
print('\\noptimal PC1 split k',best[1],sorted(n[order[:best[1]]].tolist()))
print('scores')
for i in np.argsort(n): print(n[i],round(p[i],2))
